query: Who won the 2025 Romanian presidential election?
answer: Nicușor Dan won the 2025 Romanian presidential election. Dan is a pro-European independent and was then mayor of Bucharest. He beat George Simion, the hard-right leader of the AUR party, in the runoff on 18 May 2025, taking about 54% of the vote [1][2]. The official final count was about 53.6% to 46.4%, though some early reports gave slightly higher numbers for Dan. Simion conceded, the Constitutional Court confirmed the result, and Dan was sworn in on 26 May 2025 [3][4]. The 2025 vote was a rerun, held because the 2024 election was annulled over campaign irregularities and alleged foreign interference [2].
